releases.notes:
## Toggle Beacon Beams v0.2.2 🎉
- Bump version, updated README, and changed dependency targets
- Fixed NeoForge metadata causing the game to fail to initialize on NeoForge
- Improved hide-all behavior so it works client-side and still allows individual beacon exceptions
- Disabling the mod in the config now preserves beacon hidden states while restoring vanilla beam rendering, and re-enabling restores the saved hidden states
- Fixed local fallback toggles to properly clear stale overrides and save less often
- Reduced unnecessary work in loaded-beacon refresh and bulk toggle paths
- Beacon UI rendering now caches toggle state and avoids repeated lookups for optimization

### Toggle Beacon Beams v0.2.1 🎉
- Bump version and updated README
- Added client-only fallback mode with server-side detection so the mod automatically chooses between synced server toggles or local client-only toggles (Jag)
- Added local toggle storage for client-only mode, keeping hidden beacon states per world, dimension, and beacon position (Jag)
- Batched client-only “hide/show all loaded beacons” saves so the local toggle file is written once instead of once per beacon
- Reduced redundant beacon block updates when toggling beams
- Other random code cleanup and trimmed a few repeated block-state lookups

### Toggle Beacon Beams v0.2.0 - Migrated to 26.1
- Bump version
- Replaced GuiGraphics with new GuiGraphicsExtractor class
- Implemented new logic for how the inactive beacon button is handled to support the new refactor
- README and metadata tweaks

releases.notes:
## Changelog for Toggle Beacon Beams First Release / 0.1.1 Hotfix!

TBB v0.1.1 Hotfix
- Bump version
- Fixed README typos
- Removed the reflected BeaconScreen$BeaconPowerButton entirely, the beacon toggle now uses a normal invisible Button for interaction instead of reflecting a mapping-specific inner class which caused issues when compiled

TBB first release!
- Bump version and updated metadata
- Changed mod ID to remove hyphens because NeoForge is dumb (Neo is now supported)
- Added custom sprites for new beacon UI toggle buttons and custom mod icon (MandaLin)
- Adjusted BeaconScreenMixin logic to handle the button texture better than a hacky mask layering

Toggle Beacon Beams 0.1.0-beta3
- Bump version and some code cleanup. Last beta build before 0.1.0 release. Just gotta add a README, custom sprites, and get NeoForge truly supported (Also, I may have missed some things, this was a big changelog)
- Config screen adjustments:
  - Added a new config flag modEnabled so the mod (UI button + hidden beam suppression) can be enabled/disabled from the config screen on singleplayer
  - Dropped "On" and "Off" button components in favor of individual conditional "showAll" and "hideAll" config buttons
  - Attempting to access the config screen returns client to game on servers, and disables the config screen server-side
- Fixed some client-server desync issues, notably:
  - Fixed beacon screen toggle-state desync while moving, since BeaconScreen now captures the beacon block position on init and keeps reading hidden state from that fixed position. This prevents our custom UI button from getting stuck on one state while client position is moving outside the screen
  - New fallback to re-acquire the beacon position so state lookup is resilient
  - Fixed a multiplayer-only beacon click issue by switching beacon UI clicks back to using TOGGLE_BEAM_BUTTON_ID when connected to multiplayer, while still keeping explicit HIDE/SHOW IDs in singleplayer. This avoids hide/show mismatch on servers.
  - Updated the toggle action itself to compute hide/show from current world stat before applying changes, keeping behavior aligned with the label
- Fixed some naming conventions leftover from original name, Let There Be Light:
  - Changed serialization key to tbb_hidden from original ltbl_hidden
  - Fixed the config .json from being incorrectly labeled handsoffmyblock, the name of my other mod which I copied the same config manager from, to tbb.json :/
  - Added new and updated translations

Toggle Beacon Beams 0.1.0-beta2
- Removed janky af implementation of beamToggle$hideVanillaCancelButton() and deletion of the albeit useless vanilla Cancel button
- Added proper beacon button (rather than addRenderableWidget()) into BeaconScreen to match the style of the UI
- Removed temporary (and kinda broken) "toggle all beams" keybind in favor of a [very incomplete] config screen widget
- Fixed button "double-clicking" issues when toggling all beams by handling TOGGLE_BEAM_BUTTON_ID server-side only in AbstractContainerMenuMixin
- Code cleanup and bump version
- Custom toggle button sprites, better server-side compatibility, and complete config screen w/ translations, coming soon™

Working on BeaconScreenMixin
- Switching to addBeaconButton() instead of using addRenderableWidget() to match other beacon UI buttons
- Added translations for en_us
